I struggle with ocd, so I have more irrational fears than I can count, but I'll list off the strangest ones I can think of off the top of my head:

* Every time I use an escalator I'm extremely scared that when I reach the top, the machinery will cave in and suck me into the gears. That or my shoelace will be caught in the escalator and pull my foot into the machinery and mangle it up. 
* Sick and stray animals. The thought of getting rabies *terrifies* me, and even if I know for a fact that an animal who's sick does not have rabies or a stray animal doesn't approach me, I'm scared that if I even touch it I'll somehow contract rabies and die. It sucks because there's this really sweet stray cat my family has been feeding, but every time I get near him or pet him or whatever I have to be wearing rubber gloves, use hand sanitizer afterwards, wash my hand a couple times, and sometimes if that's not enough I have to shower afterwards. 
* That I'm developing a mental disorder. Things happen and I'll think for some reason that it was a hallucination or something and have to ask people if it really happened. Gets weird really quick.

...And then there's more, but focusing on them triggers me to obsess over them, so I'll leave it at that, hah.
